title: Markdown
summary: A read-only view of Markdown text, drawn with the toolkit's own parser and renderer (the one behind pk-markdown-editor's preview): DOM calls only, so raw HTML is shown as text, a link must be http, https, mailto or a relative address, and nothing from the source becomes markup. The Markdown subset is paragraphs, bold, italic, code, fenced code, headings 1 to 6 (each with a slug id, so a #anchor link scrolls to it), quotes, lists, links, images (also inside link text: [![alt](a.png)](page.md) is a linked image) and pipe tables (a table scrolls sideways inside the element). A click on a relative link raises pk-link-click, so the app routes or rewrites it; set baseUrl and every relative link and image carries its final address in the DOM. After each draw pk-markdown-render hands the page the content root, so it can replace a diagram fence (pre > code.language-mermaid) with its own rendered node. Use it instead of writing rendered HTML into the page yourself.

props.name: markdown
props.description: The Markdown text to show. Text longer than 200000 characters is cut and a note is added.

props.name: interceptLinks
props.description: Cancel the click on a relative link (not an #anchor, not an absolute address) so the page does not navigate; pk-link-click still reports its address. Without it the link navigates unless a pk-link-click listener calls preventDefault. A click with a modifier key or a middle click is left to the browser.

props.name: baseUrl
props.description: The address relative links and images are resolved against (http, https or a path relative to the page), for example the folder of the Markdown file: the DOM then carries the final address, so hover, copy link, middle click and crawlers work. An #anchor is left alone. Empty keeps addresses as written. A link whose address was resolved is no longer relative, so it does not raise pk-link-click. JS only: resolveUrl = (url, kind) => address | null replaces it; the result is still checked.

events.name: pk-link-click
events.description: A relative link was clicked: href is its address as written. Cancel it (preventDefault), or set interceptLinks, to route or rewrite it yourself.

events.name: pk-markdown-render
events.description: The text was drawn: root is the content element (the shadow part content), for example to replace pre > code.language-mermaid blocks with a rendered diagram. Fires after every draw.

a11y: Headings, lists, quotes and links are real elements, so the text keeps its structure for assistive technology; a heading takes its place in the page outline.
